concept.title: The Tides of Fenholm
concept.logline: On storm-lashed, mysterious Fenholm, you set out to recover the lantern cores and restore the Tide Shrine.
concept.source_prompt: Storm Isle. storm stormy lighthouse island adventure Classic quest chain
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Harbour Village and becomes the one who brings the Tide Shrine back to life.

key_locations.name: Harbour Village
key_locations.description: The start: the fishing village and its quay.

key_locations.name: Sea Cave
key_locations.description: Sea Cave: a cave of Fenholm, reached by the trail from Harbour Village.

key_locations.name: Palm Grove
key_locations.description: Palm Grove: a grove on the way out from Harbour Village.

key_locations.name: Tide Shrine
key_locations.description: Tide Shrine: the far end of the compact trail, where the story ends.

characters.name: Keeper Piet
characters.description: Waits in Harbour Village and knows why the Tide Shrine fell silent.

characters.name: Odo the Deckhand
characters.description: Follows you from Harbour Village and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Reef Stalker
characters.description: A reef stalker that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Ember the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Fenholm for anything shiny.

characters.name: Sand Piper
characters.description: A harmless sand piper that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Speak with Keeper Piet in Harbour Village
hazards: Storm sweeping the exposed ground around the Tide Shrine
Reef Stalker hunting near its lair

objectives.title: Speak with Keeper Piet
objectives.description: Keeper Piet is waiting in Harbour Village and knows what has gone wrong.

objectives.title: Find the Sea Cave Lantern Core
objectives.description: It lies somewhere around Sea Cave.

objectives.title: Find the Palm Grove Lantern Core
objectives.description: It lies somewhere around Palm Grove.

objectives.title: Find the Tide Shrine Lantern Core
objectives.description: It lies somewhere around Tide Shrine.

objectives.title: Open the Sea Cave
objectives.description: Sea Cave: a cave of Fenholm, reached by the trail from Harbour Village. (Open the chest)

objectives.title: Awaken the Palm Grove
objectives.description: Palm Grove: a grove on the way out from Harbour Village. (Touch the altar)

objectives.title: Journey to the Tide Shrine
objectives.description: With everything gathered, make for the Tide Shrine.

objectives.title: Awaken the Tide Shrine
objectives.description: Tide Shrine: the far end of the compact trail, where the story ends.

objectives.title: Chat with Odo the Deckhand
objectives.description: Your companion has a few ideas.

objectives.title: Chat with Ember the Trader
objectives.description: Ember the Trader may know something useful.

objectives.title: Chat with Sand Piper
objectives.description: Sand Piper may know something useful.

objectives.title: Check the notice board in Harbour Village

actions.value: On storm-lashed, mysterious Fenholm, you set out to recover the lantern cores and restore the Tide Shrine.
Keeper Piet: "Find what was lost around Sea Cave, Palm Grove, then bring the Tide Shrine back."
You found the Sea Cave Lantern Core.
You found the Palm Grove Lantern Core.
You found the Tide Shrine Lantern Core.
The Sea Cave stirs back to life.
The Palm Grove stirs back to life.
Everything is ready. Head for the Tide Shrine.
The Tide Shrine blazes to life. The Tides of Fenholm is saved.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: So you've come to Harbour Village at last. I am Keeper Piet. On storm-lashed, mysterious Fenholm, you set out to recover the lantern cores and restore the Tide Shrine.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: Back again. Harbour Village is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: Go to Sea Cave, then Palm Grove. Whatever still remembers The Tides of Fenholm is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Harbour Village, The Tides of Fenholm was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Tense, even then.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: Sea Cave: Sea Cave: a cave of Fenholm, reached by the trail from Harbour Village.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of The Tides of Fenholm back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Piet
nodes.text: Palm Grove: Palm Grove: a grove on the way out from Harbour Village.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Deckhand
nodes.text: Odo the Deckhand circles your feet, then looks toward Sea Cave as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Deckhand
nodes.text: Odo the Deckhand hums quietly, the way it does before the weather turns.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Deckhand
nodes.text: It turns toward Sea Cave. Sea Cave: a cave of Fenholm, reached by the trail from Harbour Village.

nodes.speaker: Reef Stalker
nodes.text: The reef stalker watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Ember the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Harbour Village. Ember the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Ember the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of The Tides of Fenholm that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Ember the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Palm Grove after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Sand Piper
nodes.text: The sand piper freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
